title: Scan to folder: access denied
symptom: Scanning to a network folder from the printer fails with access denied
user_description: When I scan to the Accounts folder, the printer says access denied. It worked last month. I have 50 invoices to scan!

options.text: Give Everyone full control of the scan folder
options.why: Lets anyone change or delete scanned invoices. Far too much access.

options.text: Type her own username and password into the printer
options.why: Her password would be stored on a shared device and break when she changes it.

options.text: Check the folder path, that the account the printer uses has not had its password changed or expired, and that it has permission to write to the folder
options.why: Scan to folder uses a saved account. A changed password or missing write permission are the usual causes.

options.text: Switch her to scanning by USB instead
options.why: Avoids the problem and is not practical for a shared printer.

hints: Which account does the printer use to save scans?
What changes over time that could break a saved login?
What permission does it need on the folder?
real_world_tip: The printer's web page usually shows the saved scan settings. Update the password there once the account owner has reset it.
